verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI can be extended with third-party capabilities by configuring MCP servers in settings.json, and the docs show an example of invoking a GitHub integration (@github). This is tool-level extensibility, not integration of partner-built agent apps. Missing for 10: a documented partner or third-party agent app ecosystem or marketplace, evidence of integrating full partner agents rather than MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration of partner integrations.
